Subject: [geospatial] [#maptimeDavis] Join us at the #maptimeDavis Lightning Talk session! Sign up now!

 

Have you recently made an interesting map for your research? Collected a new spatial dataset? Taken an epic drone pic? Drawn a cool map for your D&D campaign? If so, then you should sign up for the 2024 #maptimeDavis Lightning Talk session!

 

What is a lightning talk session? Think of it like a show-and-tell of all things geospatial, cartographic, GIS, and more! Each speaker will have 5 minutes to share what they've been working on, think of it like a mapping show-and-tell. Anything that can spark discussion and collaboration across the UC Davis geospatial community is welcome! Anyone who is working on (or thinking about) a project involving spatial data – undergraduates, graduate students, postdocs, staff, faculty, and community members are encouraged to join us. This is a great time to share your progress, get new ideas, or learn more about research happening on campus :)

 

If you are interested in doing a lightning talk, please use this form to sign up. The lightning talk session will be held on Friday, November 1st from 10am-12 in the the Physical and Data Sciences Building, previously known as PSEL (Physical Sciences & Engineering Library), Seminar Room (room 1025).

 

If you have any questions/comments/concerns, please reach out to Lauren Mabe at lm...@ucdavis.edu

Lauren Mabe
